end.summary:
Defined physical changes using shape, size or state change and no new substance; gave examples such as melting ghee, wax and pressing aluminium.
Defined chemical changes as forming a new substance and identified gas, colour change, heat, light, smell and new solid as signs.
Distinguished melting from dissolving and explained that dissolved sugar or salt is still present and can be recovered.
Initially used reversibility as the main rule for classification; later stated that new-substance evidence is more important.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying physical and chemical changes from evidence, including melting, dissolving, rusting, curdling milk and burning. They explained several chemical-change signs and correctly noted that dissolved substances remain present. Ananya initially treated reversibility as the rule, but later corrected this by saying that whether a new substance forms is more important. At home, ask them to classify three everyday changes and give the evidence for each.

skills.skill: Define a physical change (no new substance; only shape, size or state changes) and give examples
Define a chemical change (a new substance with new properties forms) and recognise its signs: gas, colour change, heat or light, new smell, new solid
Classify everyday changes using evidence, knowing that 'can it be reversed?' is a clue but not the rule
Tell melting apart from dissolving and know that dissolved substances are still present

turns.text: Wo toh chemical hoga? Kyuki doodh phat raha hai, fir se wapas doodh nahi ban sakta na... smell bhi khatti aati hai. Aur doodh pehle jaisa nahi raha, wo alag ho gaya. Isliye chemical.

Doodh ka khatta smell aana aur pehle jaise properties na rehna achchha saboot hai. Sirf wapas doodh na ban paana kaafi nahi; chemical badlav mein naya padarth banta hai. Ab poster kaatne aur sparkler jalne ko compare kijiye: chemical badlav kaunsa hai, aur sirf reversibility se faisla kyon nahi kar sakte?

Sparkler chemical hai na? Jalne se naya padarth... matlab raakh aur wo chamakne wali cheez, wo pehle sparkler mein nahi thi. Poster katne se sirf shape badli, poster hi hai bas strips mein. To wo physical. Reversibility se nahi kar sakte kyuki... dono ko wapas pehle jaisa banana mushkil hai, lekin poster ka koi naya substance nahi bana. Isliye naya substance wala evidence zyada important hai, na k

Aapne poster ki strips aur sparkler ki raakh ko naya padarth banne ke sawaal se compare kiya. Ab ek aur farq dekhein: Kunal kehta hai ki paani mein namak pighal jaata hai. Use kaunsa shabd bolna chahiye, aur yeh pighalne se kaise alag hai?

Woh 'ghulna' word use karna chahiye na? Kyuki namak... matlab, wo gayab nahi hua, bas paani mein mix ho gaya. Pighalne mein toh cheez garam karke liquid banti hai, jaise chocolate ko garam kiya toh pighli. Lekin yahan namak solid hi tha, paani ne use... ghula diya? Aur chocolate wapas thanda karke solid bana sakte hain, lekin namak wala paani... uska kya? Pata nahi, wo wapas solid namak kaise nikl

Namak ko paani se nikaalne ke liye paani ko sukhne dein: paani bhaap bankar nikalta hai aur namak bachta hai. Chocolate garam hokar liquid banti hai, par namak paani mein ghulta hai. Ab agar taraazu par tole hue paani mein do chammach cheeni gholein, toh kul wazan badhega, utna hi rahega ya ghatega?

Wazan... badhega? Kyuki cheeni dali na, toh total cheezein badh gayin... lekin wo ghul gayi toh dikhti nahi, par hai toh sahi. Matlab, jaise namak wala example tha, wo sukhane par wapas milta hai, toh gayab nahi hua. Isliye wazan badhega, do chammach jitna? Par taraazu... dikhao, taraazu dikhao na?

Haan, wazan badhega, kyunki cheeni dikhna band hoti hai par paani mein rehti hai. Taraazu ka sketch banati hoon; asli taraazu ki tasveer abhi nahi dikha sakti. Ab ek drink mein sugar paani mein ghulti hai aur doosre mein chocolate garam hokar liquid banti hai: kis mein ghulna hua aur kis mein pighalna?

Dissolving toh pehle wale ne kiya na, sugar paani mein... wo ghul gaya, dikhta nahi par hai, jaise aapne namak wala bataya. Aur sugar ab bhi hai, kyuki aapne kaha tha wazan badhega, toh gayab nahi hua. Chocolate wala pighalna hai, wo garam karke liquid bana. Par... wo wapas jam sakta hai, toh physical. Haan, sugar wala dissolving, chocolate wala melting. Ek baat batao, aapne jo whiteboard pe likha
Us par namak-paani aur garam chocolate ke examples likhe hain; aap usmein kya poochna chahte the?
Wo... whiteboard pe likha hai 'Namak + paani → namak wa'... aadha hai. Aapne aage likhna band kardia? Pooch rahi thi ki sugar ab hai na, to wo aapne bol dia, haan hai. To dissolving sugar ne kiya.

Haan, board par 'namak wa' aadha reh gaya tha, meri galti. Main use saaf karke poora likh rahi hoon. Aapne sugar ka ghulna aur chocolate ka pighalna alag bataya; sugar paani mein ab bhi hai. Ab iron railing par laal-bhoori parat bane, jiske gun iron se alag hain, toh yeh physical change hai ya chemical change?

wo chemical change hoga, kyuki nayi cheez ban gayi na... laal-bhoori parat, wo iron nahi hai, alag properties hain aapne kaha. jaise rusting wala chapter tha, naya padarth. par rusting ka photo dikhao na? ya lohe ki railing ka, laal-bhoori wali?

Haan, chemical change: railing par iron se alag gun wali laal-bhoori parat bani hai. Zang lagi railing ki tasveer ban rahi hai; tab tak sochiye, lohe par khurduri laal-bhoori parat kaisi dikhegi. Ab do saaf liquids milkar dhundhle ho jaayein aur safed solid bane, toh chemical change ka sabse mazboot saboot kya hoga?
wo to... naya solid bana na? matlab safed wala jo neeche baitha, wo pehle dono liquids mein nahi tha, to naya padarth ban gaya. isliye chemical change hua. solid dikhao na? safed wala jo bana?

Aap us safed solid ko dekhna chahti hain. Uski tasveer ban rahi hai; tab tak sochiye, do saaf liquids milne ke baad glass ke neeche safed padarth jama dikhega. Aise badlav ke do aur sanket kya ho sakte hain?

sanket... matlab jaise smell change hona, wo doodh wale mein tha na? aur ek aur... heat? jaise sparkler mein light bhi aati thi, wo bhi sanket hai kya? maine toh light dekhi thi, wo chemical ka signal tha. aur haan, picture abhi tak nahi aayi, safed solid ki! dikhao na please?

Haan, smell badalna aur heat ya light nikalna chemical change ke sanket ho sakte hain; akela sanket pakka saboot nahi hota. Safed solid ki tasveer abhi nahi aayi hai, isliye main uska seedha sketch bana rahi hoon; tasveer bhi banne ke liye bhej rahi hoon.

dekho, maine toh kaafi saare bata diye... smell change, solid banana, heat, light. ab aapke paas aur kya bache hain, colour change? jaise rusting mein woh laal-bhoora colour aaya, woh bhi ek sanket hai na?

Haan, rang badalna bhi ek sanket hai; zang mein laal-bhoora rang dikhta hai. Aapne smell, naya solid, heat aur light bhi bataye the. Safed solid ki tasveer abhi nahi aayi hai. Ab kitchen wali situation mein ek physical aur ek chemical badlav kaunsa hoga?

socho... physical badlav... matlab, jaise ghee pighalna? woh toh garam karke liquid banta hai, aur wapas jam sakta hai, toh physical. aur chemical... ooh, mithai mein kuch pak raha hai na, toh chemical change... jaise sugar ko garam kiya toh caramel banta hai, woh alag cheez hai, colour bhi badalta hai, smell bhi aati hai, toh chemical hua. haan, ghee pighalna physical, aur cheeni ka caramel banan

Ghee pighalne mein state badalti hai; cheeni ko caramel banate waqt rang aur smell badalte hain. Ab ek tricky case: aluminium sheet ko dabaakar lunchbox ka dhakkan banaya, aur kuch milaya nahi. Yeh physical change hai ya chemical, aur naya padarth bana kya?
physical change hai, kyuki sirf shape badli na... aluminium ko dabaya bas, kuch milaya nahi. naya padarth nahi bana, dhakkan bhi aluminium hi hai. par dhakkan ki photo dikhao? ya aluminium sheet ki?

Bilkul, sirf shape badli; dhakkan ab bhi aluminium hai, naya padarth nahi bana. Aluminium sheet aur lunchbox ke dhakkan ki tasveer ban rahi hai. Tab tak ek challenge: card par diye badlavon ko physical aur chemical mein kaise baantenge?
